items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL for Sunday; Rapoport notes not expected to play, Adams to carry load. McVay: barring setback could return next week vs Eagles.
items.implication: Adams primary WR1 target share spike
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on 142 routes sans Nacua historically

items.text: ETR Sunday injuries: IN Nabers/Etienne/Dobbins/Harvey/Price/Darnold/Murray/Jones; Q Bowers/Flowers/Evans/DJ Moore/Warren/Pittman; D Nacua; OUT Daniels/Collins/Dowdle/Brooks/Pierce/Dart/Njoku et al.
items.implication: Clear actives boost floor; Qs monitored; OUTs create vacums

items.text: Commanders officially ruled out QB Jayden Daniels for Sunday. Rapoport: positive longer-term news, Mariota starts.
items.why: Injury; only this weekend ruled out
items.implication: Mariota start; WAS pass game downgrade short-term but Daniels not long-term concern

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indy due to hamstring.
items.implication: Houston pass catchers elevated; Schultz target share boost
items.opportunity: Schultz had 28% target share last week sans Collins

items.text: Steelers ruled out RB Rico Dowdle (toe) vs Bengals. Warren questionable (shoulder).
items.opportunity: Coach: Warren will lead group, fresh as possible; checkdown heavy if vertical fails

items.text: Projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags. Hoping early clarity on Flowers/Moore/Mitchell.
items.implication: Start them if needed; DFS viability

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs sets new ETR record ceiling projection at 44.0 (avg of top 25th percentile sim outcomes) for Week 3 main slate.
Broncos: J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey off injury report, good to go vs Rams. Jonah Coleman OUT (ankle).
items.implication: Full DEN RB committee available; Coleman out removes one piece

items.text: With Dowdle out, Jaylen Warren leads PIT RBs; vertical pass not working for Rodgers so expect zillion checkdowns to Warren. Projecting Warren (Q shoulder) in. Backups: Homer + Heidenreich.
items.why: Coach comments + Dowdle OUT + usage projection
items.opportunity: Lead carries + checkdowns; projected IN despite Q

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games in 3 seasons). Chuba Hubbard firmly lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
Davante Adams 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted on 60 (42%). Prior misses: 5-35-3 and 8-195-2.
items.implication: Adams WR1 with massive target rate if Nacua misses

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (high prop, DAL 30th rush D); Chase Brown @PIT (20+ touches, 15% tgt, PIT soft vs RBs).
items.opportunity: Henry volume vs weak run D; Brown dual-threat

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV (double-digit tgts, high aDOT, LV soft vs WR); Dalton Schultz @IND (28% tgt sans Collins, IND soft vs TE); Christian Watson vs ATL (WR8 util, RZ share).
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz volume vacuum; Watson RZ

items.text: Hates Travis Etienne vs LV (low util/snaps/3rd down even w/ Kamara); Rhamondre Stevenson @JAX (low snaps post-fumble, tough run D); Terry McLaurin vs SEA (SEA stingy vs WR, low WAS total).
items.opportunity: Etienne only 49% touches/38% 3rd downs; Stevenson 31% snaps
